line.label: I 8 eastbound
line.how: ref 'I 8' eastbound: the longest directed chain

declared._doc: THE LINE THE SHIP PHASE WALKS (scripts.geometry.network_reference, the draft step network_reference; Kevin 2026-11-01: 'a complete track list installed by morning'). A network has no single centreline, and the prep / write_ai_line / make_map / verify_kn5 / drive_test read one (tracks/san-diego-freeway/README.md 'What the Windows run owes'). This declares ONE real mainline, never an invented one (fleet/LAWS.md L1): Interstate 8 eastbound, end to end inside source.bbox, chosen from the draft's OWN edges at draft time. ref 'I 8' is one of source.refs, the OSM ref tag scripts.gps.classify writes as a motorway edge's name; eastbound = the carriageway whose OSM ways are drawn west to east (classify travel_dir, recorded because this block exists), the right-hand one of the pair (checked: where I 8 westbound runs within 80 m it must lie on the line's left). The resolver takes the longest directed chain of non-ramp I 8 edges that continue each other at a shared node (no joint turning > max_joint_turn_deg); every point of the line is a vertex of a built edge. Edge ids are not written here: they are the draft's own and change with every net step on live OSM (the README: no snapshot of the July OSM exists); edge_ids may pin a list once a draft is read. Everything else the network builds (I 8 westbound, I 5, CA 52, CA 163, every ramp and connector) is in track.obj and the kn5 but walked by no line gate: data/network.reference.json lists it by id and name, drive_test prints it, ship.json _owed names the hole.
declared._bridge_max_edges_doc: [invented] At most 2 non-ramp freeway edges of ANOTHER name may sit INSIDE the chain (never at its ends; each named in network.reference.json 'bridged'): classify names a mainline piece by a nearest-way vote every 25 m, and a short I 8 piece passing under the CA 163 or I 5 stack can lose that vote. Only non-ramp freeway edges can bridge (OSM tags freeway-to-freeway connectors motorway_link, which classify makes ramps), only between two I 8 eastbound edges (the chain starts and ends on I 8), and only through joints turning <= max_joint_turn_deg. 0 = refuse instead.

_doc: The ship phase walks ONE line: drive_test (10 wheel paths), write_ai_line and make_map's lap follow it, verify_kn5's spawns sit on it. Every edge listed in 'unjudged' is BUILT (in track.obj and the kn5) but no line-walking gate drives it; audit_mesh, verify_kn5's mesh checks and kn5_ground_check read the whole mesh. A hole, named here, never hidden.
